response.title: A Novel Ensemble Deep Learning Model for Stock Prediction Based on Stock Prices and News
response.label_definition: Predict the next day's adjusted closing stock price using the past 10 trading days of financial news compound scores from multiple sources and adjusted closing prices; movement direction metrics are computed from predicted versus actual stock movement direction.
data_requirements: Daily S&P 500 Index adjusted closing prices for trading days from 2017-12-07 through 2018-06-01.
Daily financial news compound scores aligned by date from WSJ, Reuters, CBNC, and Fortune.
Dataset must exclude weekends and remove null records.
Dataset must contain 121 trading days and six columns: date, four news compound score columns, and adjusted closing price.
Chronological split: training 2017-12-07 to 2018-04-09, validation 2018-04-10 to 2018-05-04, test 2018-05-07 to 2018-06-01.
feature_groups: past 10 trading days of adjusted closing prices
past 10 trading days of WSJ news compound scores
past 10 trading days of Reuters news compound scores
past 10 trading days of CBNC news compound scores
past 10 trading days of Fortune news compound scores
response.training_protocol: Use a rolling window of fixed size 10 over chronological daily trading data. Train level-0 recurrent neural network sub-models on the training split. Use sub-model predictions on the validation split to form a p x m intermediate dataset for the level-1 meta-learner. Train the level-1 fully connected neural network meta-learner on that intermediate validation-derived dataset. At test time, feed test data into the sub-models to produce intermediate test predictions, then feed those intermediate predictions to the meta-learner for final predictions. Reported split-derived window counts are 83 training time steps, 9 validation time steps, and 9 test time steps.
response.evaluation_protocol: Fixed chronological holdout evaluation. Training data are from 2017-12-07 to 2018-04-09, validation data are from 2018-04-10 to 2018-05-04, and test data are from 2018-05-07 to 2018-06-01. The training split trains level-0 sub-models, the validation split trains/prepares the level-1 meta-learner, and the test split evaluates prediction performance. This is not reported as walk-forward validation.
response.preprocessing_protocol: Remove all null data. Combine news data and stock data by date. Exclude weekends because the stock market only opens and closes during weekdays. Use six columns: date, WSJ news compound score, Reuters news compound score, CBNC news compound score, Fortune news compound score, and adjusted closing price. Rescale adjusted closing stock prices to the range [0, 1]. The paper states compound scores are between -1 and 1; it does not specify an additional transformation for compound scores. The paper does not specify whether price normalization parameters are fit only on the training split or on the full dataset.
strict_requirements: Use the S&P 500 Index as the only target asset.
Use adjusted closing prices as the stock-price series.
Use WSJ, Reuters, CBNC, and Fortune news compound scores as news inputs.
Predict the next day's stock price.
Use the chronological train/validation/test split reported in the paper.
Train level-0 recurrent neural network sub-models on the training split and train the fully connected meta-learner using intermediate predictions prepared from the validation split.
Evaluate only on the test period from 2018-05-07 to 2018-06-01.
Report the Blending Ensemble row, not LSTM, DP-LSTM, GRU, Averaging Ensemble, or Weighted Average Ensemble baselines.

The model employs a blending ensemble learning method to combine two recurrent neural networks (RNNs) followed by a fully connected neural network (FCNN).
The training dataset is used to train the level 0 sub-models, the validation dataset is used to prepare the level 1 model, and the test dataset used to evaluate our prediction performance.
The meta-learner is a fully-connect neural network with three layers; the activation function for this model is the Rectiﬁed Linear Unit (ReLu).
The training data are those obtained from 12/07/2017 to 04/09/2018; the validation data are those data between 04/10/2018 and 05/04/2018; the test data are from 05/07/2018 to 06/01/2018.

During the experiments, we mainly use four different evaluation metrics: mean square error (MSE), confusion matrix, mean prediction accuracy (MPA) and Movement Direction Accuracy (MDA) to evaluate the Blending Ensemble model.
